verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents its own deletion and retrieval APIs for GDPR compliance, and publishes a GDPR & CCPA OpenAPI spec usable by AI agents, so the deletion half of the story is covered. Nothing shows user control over how long data is kept. Missing for 10: configurable data-retention periods or policies, detail on deletion scope and behavior (events vs. profiles, timelines), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Mixpanel deletion and retrieval APIs are in place to help Mixpanel implementations meet the requirements outlined by the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) legislation.
Every Mixpanel API is described by an OpenAPI specification. Use these to generate client code, validate requests
